questions.question: [NEET 2021 | Biology] The correct sequence of taxonomic hierarchy from highest to lowest is:

options.A: Kingdom \u₂₁₉₂ Phylum \u₂₁₉₂ Class \u₂₁₉₂ Order \u₂₁₉₂ Family \u₂₁₉₂ Genus \u₂₁₉₂ Species
options.B: Kingdom \u₂₁₉₂ Class \u₂₁₉₂ Phylum \u₂₁₉₂ Order \u₂₁₉₂ Family \u₂₁₉₂ Genus \u₂₁₉₂ Species
options.C: Species \u₂₁₉₂ Genus \u₂₁₉₂ Family \u₂₁₉₂ Order \u₂₁₉₂ Class \u₂₁₉₂ Phylum \u₂₁₉₂ Kingdom
options.D: Kingdom \u₂₁₉₂ Phylum \u₂₁₉₂ Order \u₂₁₉₂ Class \u₂₁₉₂ Family \u₂₁₉₂ Genus \u₂₁₉₂ Species

questions.solution: # Correct Answer: **(A) Kingdom \u₂₁₉₂ Phylum \u₂₁₉₂ Class \u₂₁₉₂ Order \u₂₁₉₂ Family \u₂₁₉₂ Genus \u₂₁₉₂ Species** --- ## Step-by-Step Explanation The taxonomic hierarchy follows a **nested classification system** where each level becomes progressively more specific: | Rank | Level | Breadth | Example | |------|-------|---------|---------| | 1 | **Kingdom** | Broadest | Animalia | | 2 | **Phylum** | \u₂₁₉₃ | Chordata | | 3 | **Class** | \u₂₁₉₃ | Mammalia | | 4 | **Order** | \u₂₁₉₃ | Primates | | 5 | **Family** | \u₂₁₉₃ | Hominidae | | 6 | **Genus** | \u₂₁₉₃ | Homo | | 7 | **Species** | Narrowest | sapiens | --- ## Memory Aid (Mnemonic) **"King Philip Came Over For Good Soup"** - **K**ing, **P**hilip, **C**ame, **O**ver, **F**or, **G**ood, **S**oup - Helps remember: Kingdom, Phylum, Class, Order, Family, Genus, Species --- ## Why Other Options Are Wrong - **(B)**: Incorrectly places Class before Phylum - wrong sequence - **(C)**: This is completely reversed (Species to Kingdom instead of Kingdom to Species) - **(D)**: Incorrectly places Order before Class - violates the correct hierarchical order --- ## Key Concept to Remember \u₂₇₁₃ **Taxonomic hierarchy moves from the most general (Kingdom) to the most specific (Species)** \u₂₇₁₃ Each organism belongs to exactly one taxon at each level \u₂₇₁₃ The lower you go in the hierarchy, the fewer organisms share those characteristics
